title: Skill Registry
description: Schema for skill_registry.json — the single source of truth for which skills exist, their portability classification, and their declared dependencies. A strict subset of agent_registry.schema.json (same structural pattern; omits agent-only fields: spawn_allowlist, spawned_by, is_ticket_phase, selection_criteria, model).

skills.description: List of all skills in the leafcutter ecosystem.

id.description: Unique skill identifier — matches the directory name under .claude/skills/ and (for portable skills) leafcutter/templates/skills/.

portable.description: True if the skill is domain-agnostic and belongs in the portable package (has a template_path). False for domain-specific skills (domain field non-null).

domain.description: Domain tag (e.g. 'bybit-trader') for domain-specific skills. Null for portable skills.

template_path.description: Relative path (from leafcutter root) to the skill's template directory. Present only for portable skills.

dependencies.description: Skill IDs that this skill invokes at runtime (skill-to-skill dependency graph). May be left [] for the initial pass when dependency mapping is non-trivial.
